label: gate1_debug_uncoded_bpsk

config.name: gate1_debug_uncoded_bpsk
config.description: fast debug sweep (25 frames x 3 points)

ebn0_definition: Eb/N0 is energy per information payload bit relative to N0; Es/N0 is derived per point from info_bits / actual transmitted symbols (coded bits + symbol padding), i.e. code rate, framing overhead and padding are included in one exact ratio (comms/config.py).
latency_definition: latency_* values are single-host processing time (time.perf_counter around the per-frame tx/rx chain), NOT over-the-air latency.
